scripts.text:
[Auction Hall Guide]
Hello, would you
like to enter the
Auction Hall?
scripts.translation:
[拍卖行向导]
你好，想进入拍卖行吗？

scripts.text:
[Auction Hall Guide]
Great! Well then,
I hope you have fun
and enjoy the auction~
scripts.translation:
[拍卖行向导]
太好了！
祝你玩得开心，尽情享受拍卖的乐趣吧~

[拍卖行向导]
祝你拍卖愉快。

scripts.text:
[Auction Hall Guide]
Alright then,
see you later.
If you change your
mind, please come
and enjoy the auctions~
scripts.translation:
[拍卖行向导]
好，那下次见。
如果改变主意，随时来参加拍卖哦~

scripts.text:
[Auction Broker]
Welcome to the Auction Hall.
Would you like to view the goods?
scripts.translation:
[拍卖经纪人]
欢迎来到拍卖行。
想看看拍卖品吗？

scripts.text:
[Auction Broker]
Very well.
Please take
a look, and see
What's being offered~
scripts.translation:
[拍卖经纪人]
好。
请看看都有哪些拍卖品吧~

scripts.text:
[Auction Broker]
Very well, then.
If you change your
mind, then please
come and check
out the auctions~
scripts.translation:
[拍卖经纪人]
好吧。
如果改变主意，随时来看看拍卖品哦~
